news.headline: Intermountain Health Brings Perimeter's Claire to the Operating Room, a Landmark in Breast Cancer Surgery Using AI
news.summary: Intermountain Health became the first U.S. health system to commercially deploy Perimeter's FDA-approved Claire OCT+AI system for live intraoperative breast-cancer margin assessment, installing it at LDS Hospital and American Fork Hospital in Utah under the systemwide agreement signed in January 2026. It marks Claire's first real-world clinical use since receiving FDA premarket approval in March 2026.

news.headline: Perimeter Announces Date for Second Quarter 2026 Earnings Call
news.summary: Perimeter confirmed it will report second-quarter 2026 financial and operating results after market close on Thursday, August 20, 2026, followed by a management webcast and conference call. The update is expected to include commentary on Claire's commercial rollout and cash position.

news.headline: Brookline Capital Markets Starts Perimeter Medical Imaging at Buy; PT C$1.54
news.summary: Analyst Kemp Doliver initiated coverage with a Buy rating and C$1.54 (US$1.11) price target, versus a July 13 close of C$0.32, citing Claire's FDA Breakthrough Device status as likely to speed CMS review of a planned New Technology APC reimbursement filing under Medicare's outpatient payment system. A decision on that filing is expected by year-end 2026.

news.headline: Paradigm Capital Names Perimeter a Healthcare Top Pick, Maintains Profound
news.summary: Analyst Scott McAuley named Perimeter a new Top Pick with a Speculative Buy rating and C$0.95 price target (stock closed C$0.275 on July 3), pointing to the March 2026 FDA PMA approval of Claire as setting up an accelerating commercial rollout. He noted intraoperative margin assessment is becoming a near-term focus area for medtech strategic acquirers.

catalysts.label: Q2 2026 earnings call
catalysts.detail: Perimeter reports second-quarter 2026 financial results after market close and hosts a webcast/conference call expected to cover Claire's commercial traction at Intermountain Health, installed base growth, and cash runway.

catalysts.label: CMS New Technology APC reimbursement decision
catalysts.detail: Claire's FDA Breakthrough Device designation is expected to accelerate CMS review of Perimeter's New Technology APC filing under Medicare's Hospital Outpatient Prospective Payment System; a decision is anticipated by year-end 2026, with coverage effective as early as October 1, 2026 (more likely January 1, 2027 under the standard MEARIS quarterly schedule) if granted.

catalysts.label: Broader nationwide Claire commercial rollout / additional health-system agreements
catalysts.detail: Following the first live deployment at Intermountain Health, Perimeter has signaled plans to expand Claire placements to additional high-volume surgical centers across the U.S. as part of its nationwide commercial launch.

pulse: Perimeter is pivoting from regulatory milestone to commercial execution: Intermountain Health became the first U.S. health system to put the FDA-approved Claire OCT+AI margin-assessment system into live surgical use in August 2026. Sell-side sentiment has turned more constructive, with Paradigm Capital naming the stock a Top Pick and Brookline Capital Markets initiating at Buy, both flagging Claire's Breakthrough Device status as a tailwind for an expected CMS reimbursement (New Technology APC) decision by year-end 2026. Watch the August 20, 2026 Q2 earnings call for updates on installed-base growth, cash burn, and the reimbursement timeline given the stock's small-cap, pre-profitability risk profile.
